evidence: The XDG Base Directory specification defines this root for user-specific non-essential cache data; configuration and persistent data homes remain outside it.
Apple defines Library/Caches as data applications must be able to regenerate; Application Support, preferences, containers, and user documents remain outside this root.
Windows exposes LocalCacheFolder and TemporaryFolder separately from persistent LocalFolder data; only those package children are selected and LocalState remains outside the match.
